verdict: Paid ads have not launched; all five pre-launch milestones are overdue.

Five launch milestones that were due July 31 and August 1 remain incomplete, which is holding back the $6,500/month in planned ad spend and the leads that come with it. Clearing the outstanding launch items is the immediate priority, and once ads are live you should expect paid leads to begin flowing within the first week of campaign activity.
